clientActions.ws.prepare_exception_draft: Prepare an unsaved exception draft for a resource (read-only).
clientActions.ws.run_assessment: Ask the user to confirm, then call the existing POST /api/v1/assessments.
clientActions.ws.select_scope: Re-run the investigation for another readable scope (read-only).

ApplicationReadinessPanel.description: Readiness by application, open blockers and supplied evidence.

ApprovalStatus.description: Change package status, digest-bound decisions and failing gates (read-only).

CanvasNotice.description: Plain-text notice with an info, warning or critical tone.

CanvasStack.description: Vertical layout container (children are component ids).

ControlCoverageMatrix.description: Per-scope coverage from the latest completed assessment, with stated denominator.

ControlSummary.description: Security intent, revision status, prevention boundary, implementations and next decision.

EvidencePanel.description: Data sources, provenance, freshness, confidence and limitations.

ExceptionReview.description: Exceptions with governance vs native status, disposition and expiry.

GitOpsHandoffPreview.description: Exported handoff bundle files and digests (approved does not mean deployed).

ImpactAssessment.description: Persisted impact assessment rollup (configuration, exceptions, requests, readiness).

PolicyDiffViewer.description: Existing native bindings (baseline) versus the proposed implementation revision.

ResourceImpactTable.description: Per-resource results from a persisted assessment run.

RolloutTimeline.description: Rollout rings and stage for the active plan, or the unpersisted suggested template.

ScopeSelector.description: Scopes the current identity may read; changing it re-runs the investigation.
